ruleDefinitions.name: RunDLL32 Spawning Explorer
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects RunDLL32.exe spawning explorer.exe as child, which is very uncommon, often observes Gamarue spawning the explorer.exe process in an unusual way

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\shell32\\\.dll\\,Control\\_RunDLL.*"))
